description: Order-N graph-native metacognition over executable learning plans: prediction-error residuals, non-scalar policy counterexamples, typed plan revision, discrimination requests, and conditional reopening. All cognitive quantities are integer.

rules.name: ml_attach_metacognitive_policy_to_learning_plan
rules.comment: A learning plan is itself a revisable program. The first meta-level is materialized lazily when a plan exists.

rules.name: ml_detect_exhausted_zero_yield_learning_policy
rules.comment: An exhausted body-derived budget with no new causal success falsifies the current learning-policy prediction when a productive frontier alternative exists.

rules.name: ml_apply_unique_dominating_learning_policy_revision
rules.comment: Only one verified non-dominated counterexample may enact a revision. Incomparable alternatives require discrimination.

rules.name: ml_materialize_next_meta_order_after_revision_fails
rules.comment: The reflective tower is order-N and lazy. A failed revision materializes exactly one higher order; ordinary learning does not pay for unused meta-levels.
